summary: Iteration 2 regression — all four code-review fixes verified end-to-end. Full backend test suite (17 tests, /app/backend/tests/) passes. Live SMTP email send + bulk-send counters verified against Gmail (2 sends total). UI login, dashboard live polling, add-participant modal, scanner-users nav, and scanner-login RBAC guard all work with zero page errors/warnings.

minor.issue: CORS still allow_credentials=false while login also sets httpOnly cookie; cookie will never be sent cross-site from the SPA (falls back to Bearer). Not blocking, but inconsistent with auth playbook.

action_items: Optional: reconcile CORS allow_credentials and cookie auth (playbook alignment) — currently harmless because frontend uses Bearer from JSON body.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix (1) test files now source ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD from env — verified; iter1 stale tests updated to reflect the RBAC lockdown so scanner/verify is only reachable by SCANNER role.

Fix (2) server.py current_user initializes user=None before the try; JWT decode failures and missing-user paths both raise 401 as expected — covered by test_current_user_no_token_401 and test_current_user_bad_token_401.
Fix (3) two empty catch blocks in App.js now log via console.warn (lines 107 and 160 — chime playback + dashboard poll). No unhandled console errors during a 4.5s dashboard mount.
Fix (4) bulk-send failed list key is now `r.registration_id || r.email` (App.js line 303) — stable across renders, no more index-key React warning.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login, dashboard poll, registrations, add-modal, scanner-users nav, scanner-login RBAC)

test_credentials: admin@euphoria.local / EuphoriaAdmin!2026 (from /app/backend/.env, matches /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Scanner user is generated per test via POST /api/scanner-users.
seed_data_creation: Test participants created with TEST_REG_/TEST_SCAN_/TEST_DUP_/TEST_CSV_/TEST_EMAIL_ prefixes; two live Gmail sends performed to the configured SMTP account only (registrations@sageuniversity.in).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests moved to pytest with dotenv-based env loading so `pytest backend/tests/` works without exporting envs. Scanner regression now uses pyzbar to decode the raw QR token from the base64 qr_image (libzbar0 was apt-installed). If pyzbar is missing on a fresh runner, `apt install libzbar0 && pip install pyzbar`. Live SMTP test kept out of the pytest suite to avoid flooding Gmail; validated once manually.
rca of the issue: No new issues found. All 4 review fixes behave correctly.
